categories.title: V.Week
categories.description: Only a small percentage (up to 15%) of students meet curriculum standards.

categories.title: Week
categories.description: Less than three-quarters (75%) of students attain levels that are at least in line with curriculum standards.

categories.title: Requires Improvement
categories.description: If at least 75% of students are attaining at or above the curriculum standards stated in this column.

categories.title: Good
categories.description: If at least 50% of the students are at or above the curriculum standards in this column.

categories.title: V.Good
categories.description: If at least 61% of the students are at or above the standards stated in this column.

categories.title: Outstanding
categories.description: If at least 75% of students are at or above the standards stated in this column.
